name: r4-xsretime
summary: Climb round 4: re-time the paced attention-window L2 prefetch (wo_a 4.12 MiB + wo_b 5.16 MiB, 125 GB/s, ~79 us on the shared pacer FIFO stream 3) so it finishes before the wo_b GEMM when DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT=1 shortens attention by 12-14 us/call. Three default-off levers behind new DSV41_L2_PREFETCH_* flags: per-kind attn pace rate, own attn pacer stream, attn-window dedup against the all-gather window. One base patch (6 anchors, 24 tagged lines) on the LIVE dsv41_l2_prefetch.py (r1-pf installed) + one new module. Cache hints only: exact by construction.

flags.name: DSV41_L2_PREFETCH_PACE_GBPS_ATTN
flags.meaning: pace rate (GB/s) of the attention (wo_a+wo_b) windows only; ar/ag/post windows keep PACE_GBPS. Needs PACE_GBPS>0 and 'attn' in PACE_KINDS, else logged INACTIVE. Bound (0, 400].

flags.name: DSV41_L2_PREFETCH_PACE_ATTN_STREAM
flags.meaning: paced attention windows on their own 4th side stream (created at install, joined at the end of the bracketed forward): start at the fork instead of after the all-gather pacer in the stream-3 FIFO, and the post-attention all-reduce pacer no longer queues behind them.

flags.name: DSV41_L2_PREFETCH_ATTN_DEDUP
flags.meaning: drop from every attention window the byte ranges the collective window holding its fork already prefetched (wo_b scales + first 0.69 MiB of wo_b in non-indexer layers); windows only shrink.

reference_files.note: live r1-pf module, unchanged; must stay installed

uninstall: python3 install.py uninstall  (before any r1-pf uninstall)
depends_on: r3-xsplit (installed, DSV41_ATTN_XSPLIT) for the xs arms

expected_gain_pct.vs: control (production), best xs+ arm; prod+r200 alone ~+0.3..0.5

window_arms.name: xs+r200
window_arms.note: attn windows paced at 200 GB/s (49 us instead of 79); model: done at wo_b start in 29-68% of layers, mean overrun -8..+1 us (was +22..+31)

window_arms.name: xs+own+r160
window_arms.note: own pacer stream (starts at the fork, ~13 us earlier) + 160 GB/s; model overrun -7..+2 us

window_arms.name: xs+own+r160+dedup
window_arms.note: all three; model overrun -13..-4 us, done in 58-95% of layers

window_arms.name: xs+r200+dedup
window_arms.note: single pacer FIFO kept, fastest attn, minus the AG-window wo_b head

window_arms.name: xs+own
window_arms.note: earlier start only; model overrun +10..+19 us (partial fix); isolates the FIFO effect incl. the post-attn AR pacer no longer queueing

window_arms.name: xs+wob3
window_arms.note: ENV-ONLY (no kit flag): 3 of 5.16 MiB of wo_b in the attn window; the GEMM reads the rest from DRAM uncontended

window_arms.name: prod+r200
window_arms.note: no XSPLIT: production also overruns wo_b by +6..+13 us (wo_b 14.7-18.3 us vs 13.1-14.3 when the pacer is done)

device_checks: no new kernel: the live libdsv41_l2pf_g2.so pacer / libdsv41_l2pf.so burst kernels only; no stopped-node device test needed

rank0.log per arm: 'r4-xsretime: active=' line with the expected levers and no INACTIVE; 'g2 captured tokens=N forks {... attn_y ...}' equals planned and no MISMATCH; dedup arms: moved_mb.xsr_dedup > 0
